text: Small toggle under the row, painted over. Flick it down. That's their camera on the gallery.
style: Operations manager and OT engineer at a grid battery site, mid-fifties. Speak with a consistent North-East English (Teesside) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Firm, low-to-mid pitch; brisk, clipped pace. Tonight he is on a phone line from Teesside, talking an agent through 1960s switchgear he has never seen.
